question: Where did the stored rock rows Lower Ramp Route (5.8) and Prominent Dihedral (5.10) on Mount Price (WA) come from, and should they stay, move or go?
answer: No source ties either name to Mount Price WA or to any other Price formation. Exact-name searches (alone and together, with Washington, Snoqualmie, Price Glacier/Shuksan, Garibaldi BC) returned nothing: no Mountain Project, thecrag, SummitPost or AAJ page lists a 'Prominent Dihedral' or 'Lower Ramp Route' on a Price. Mount Price WA is a non-technical routefinding scramble with only three documented ways up (Hester Lake, Northwest/Price Lake, Southeast). Mount Price in Garibaldi BC is a different peak with only hiking/ski routes, and no WA crag called Price was found. The stored rows carry no text in the packet (name, discipline alpine, grade, no track points), so there are no internal clues (crag, approach, first ascent). They look like mis-attached rows from another peak. 'The Ramp 5.8' hits are Icicle Buttress and Montana, unrelated. Beckey was not readable, so a Beckey entry is not excluded.
recommendation: Lower Ramp Route (wa_mount_price_lower_ramp_route): delete as unsupported. Prominent Dihedral (wa_mount_price_prominent_dihedral): delete as unsupported. Neither is moved: no correct peak/crag could be identified, so there is no catalog area to name. Delete only after the owner OKs, since Beckey vol 1 was not checked.
evidence: packets-all/wa_mount_price.json — both rows have only name/discipline/grade, no text or tracks
https://www.summitpost.org/mount-price/959754 — the Garibaldi BC Mount Price: hiking/ski routes only, no such climbs
https://www.summitpost.org/the-ramp-5-8/774724 — 'The Ramp 5.8' is a Montana route, not Price

"Prominent Dihedral" "Lower Ramp Route" — no page has either
